title: Just played miniature golf at Mall World.
content: The lighting was a gentle blue from lamps all over the mall with decorative railing and vines decorating the rails and walls. There were some courses that had multiple holes to sink the ball into with a colored mesh screen at the bottom of every hole. I don't think the score was determined by strokes. Instead, the color of the hole was worth so many points and each hole was more challenging to sink. The blue holes were the hardest to sink because they were on top of a tricky hill then orange was the easiest and worth the least amount and there was curved pit that would roll the ball into it if it got too close. Green, yellow, and red were in between. It was an interesting way to play.
